reservoir_ep06_001.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_001.text: On Day One Thousand Sixty-two, Qiu set the final city-access review beside the grain house's remaining work dates. The two documents concerned different obligations. Yue had five accepted grain days left and a bounded institutional receiving term to close by the seventy-fourth. Tian looked at the arrangement and said he could finally read a calendar without feeling it was a secret accusation. Zhou told him this was an excellent qualification for the next ordinary copy. Yue laughed, then asked Qiu which actual counterpart each source keeper needed returned.

reservoir_ep06_002.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_002.text: The designated local receiver could accept the permitted city report and any numbered extract under the institutions' written receiving authority. This avoided pretending that a distant courier would complete a winter road in a single afternoon. The city institution's later acknowledgment would follow its real dispatch route without prolonging access. Yue checked the agent's designation on the retained page. Closing a record term meant stopping requests, returning its property and finishing the accepted report, rather than announcing that everyone far away had already read whatever she sent.

reservoir_ep06_003.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_003.text: Jing had arranged the instrument room's ordinary maintenance for the following week. She asked Yue to keep the current city materials separate from any later candidate file. The basin's own blanks and qualified measurements would establish a new examination's evidence. A factory component extract could explain a particular past comparison, but could not become a secret advantage in a different trial. Yue put the numbered sheet in the return folder where its actual source would be visible. The sorting felt less like renouncing knowledge than making it possible to say where each useful fact belonged.

reservoir_ep06_004.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_004.text: At breakfast, Fu asked whether closure meant Yue was leaving the valley immediately. Yue said no new post had been accepted yet, but a later funded study offer might be available after the current obligations ended. Fu wanted to know whether she would still be able to ask her about the household trial. Yue pointed to the actual receiver and the permitted public account. The work did not have to disappear with the visitor. They could also speak as friends during free time, without treating every later conversation as an extension of an ended appointment.

reservoir_ep06_005.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_005.text: On Day One Thousand Sixty-three, Yue completed her twelfth accepted grain day. Zhou assigned the ordinary receiving comparison and current storage summary. A packet's old heading had been corrected clearly enough that Tian caught the date difference before asking her. He looked almost disappointed not to need help. Yue said he could still ask her to check the copied result. They compared it together against the retained original and agreed. The next person's independent look had become an ordinary part of the work, rather than proof that the first worker lacked competence.

reservoir_ep06_006.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_006.text: The day's three copper brought her completed grain wages to thirty-six before the one-copper private dispatch already paid. Zhou gave the actual receipt and asked what source she would use for the five-day interval between this term and any new funded offer. Yue would price it from completed personal wages, not the possible study allocation. The visitor house offered the current ordinary bed and meal rates. Five nights and five days of food would require ten copper. She reserved that real amount in her own purse without claiming the future offer had already been made.

reservoir_ep06_007.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_007.text: Tian brought a stack of canceled forms to the historical shelf and stopped at one whose margin held a funny sketch. He asked whether the joke needed to be preserved too. Zhou said the page's source history mattered and the drawing could stay unless it exposed something private. Yue looked at the little basket beside the old stock heading. It was Tian's own joke, already harmlessly offered around the house. He was delighted that an accurate institution had room for that much unnecessary art and carried the stack away without trimming its personality into perfect rectangles.

reservoir_ep06_008.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_008.text: Qiu's closing review needed only facts relevant to the city-access term. She would not attach Yue's mother's care letter, Fu's private household calendar or Liu's partner's whole sleep account. Each had been offered for a narrower question. The selected household trial's public counterpart could support the observer report within its actual permission, while confidential detail remained with the current owners. Yue prepared the allowed source list before writing conclusions. A report could be both useful and smaller than everything its writer now knew about the people who had made it possible.

reservoir_ep06_009.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_009.text: On Day One Thousand Sixty-four, the failed-comparison worker left for a separately booked ordinary accounting appointment at the next town. Her recovery term had reached its actual end, and she chose paid work before deciding whether to apply for another reservoir comparison. The red flower remained with its buyer's named custodian, who had accepted the temporary watering. Yue helped carry only the woman's light private bag to the sound gate. The woman wished her a good next decision, rather than predicting a pass. Yue wished her an ordinary job whose hours she could trust.

reservoir_ep06_010.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_010.text: The departure unsettled Yue more than a confident candidate's success would have. Here was someone continuing a life without settling every cultivation question first. Her wages, jokes and flower had all been real while the examination remained unfinished. Yue sat at the public veranda after the booked cart left and thought of her mother choosing shorter kiln tasks. She wanted to grow more capable, but she no longer wanted to make every valuable hour wait for the capability. The next offer would need to fit that changing wish as well as her route records.

reservoir_ep06_011.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_011.text: Jing joined her with the repaired apron folded over one arm. She had heard the worker's decision and hoped the next appointment suited her. Yue asked whether it was disappointing to maintain an examination system that people sometimes chose to leave. Jing said she maintained instruments, not a rule that everyone must want them forever. A candidate could fail, recover, take another job or return under a new accepted term. The institution's usefulness depended partly on letting those choices remain real instead of turning departure into an insult.

reservoir_ep06_012.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_012.text: On Day One Thousand Sixty-five, Yue completed her thirteenth accepted grain day. Tian's current copies needed less correction, and Zhou allowed him the ordinary receiving window while Yue checked the older stock summary. They found the isolated half-unit rejection still recorded correctly. The actual material repair had not been confused with replacing lost grain. Yue signed the limited comparison and stopped at the posted hour. Another three-copper wage brought the completed total to thirty-nine before the private dispatch expense. The five remaining days had become three actual appointments, not an indefinite command to stay.

reservoir_ep06_013.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_013.text: That evening Liu brought a burnt loaf and claimed it was historical evidence of a market morning gone wrong. Fu inspected the black edge and said history ought to be eaten carefully. Tian offered to draw it beside the basket. Zhou refused to have his grain house represented entirely by objects people had nearly ruined. Yue laughed until she had to put down the cup. The family visit she was considering would mean leaving evenings like this, not escaping a place she secretly disliked. The cost of going home had become more concrete because staying was good too.

reservoir_ep06_014.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_014.text: Fu asked whether that made the choice harder. Yue said yes, and Fu said that sounded like an actual choice. The room grew quiet for a moment before Tian said he still preferred the basket because it had at least remained uncooked. They laughed again. Yue would miss some work or conversation whichever road she later accepted. A sufficiently wise person might compare those losses carefully. She did not think wisdom meant discovering a miraculous itinerary that would let her be present at every table without anyone paying for the impossible speed.

reservoir_ep06_015.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_015.text: On Day One Thousand Sixty-six, Qiu received the city institution's confirmed local closure designation. Its current scope matched the retained receiving terms and expired with the accepted handover by the seventy-fourth. Yue could finish her actual report here, with the institutional counterpart sent onward by its ordinary route. No city wage followed her into the new basin commission. The earlier paid city days and their completed wages remained earlier facts. Qiu asked her to read the particular record she had chosen, so the closing account would not borrow a more generous neighboring option.

reservoir_ep06_016.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_016.text: Yue's retained city decision named the collective public observer and service term. Its twelve actual paid days ran from Day Nine Hundred Sixty-nine through Nine Hundred Eighty, and thirty-six copper had been paid before she departed the city. The exclusive factory stipend had been declined. Qiu checked those completed facts without converting the older wages into current basin employment. What remained here was bounded public comparative-record access and its agreed receiving closure, not twelve more days that somebody could quietly require from her.

reservoir_ep06_017.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_017.text: The closing observer account could cite the households' permitted public trial counterpart, the grain house's accepted date correction and Yue's own actual travel sources. Confidential sheets stayed out. Qiu asked which observations Yue had made personally and which belonged to the named keepers. She marked them distinctly. The broader collective channel had made some comparisons available, and its real loss of the factory stipend belonged to the same chosen path. She would finish that path honestly rather than borrowing the private component mandate she had declined.

reservoir_ep06_018.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_018.text: The local agent accepted the report's scope for final handover on the scheduled review day. Yue would return the retained public access copy as required, keeping only her permitted personal notes and prior earned practice record. Any later use of cooperative source material needed a new ordinary request. The winter city's public endorsement applied to its actual completed service, not automatically to a reservoir examination or new water appointment. Qiu wrote the ending access date visibly beside the receiving place so nobody would mistake a familiar contact for continuing authority.

reservoir_ep06_019.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_019.text: Yue's retained decision named the conditional inspected factory comparison term. Its twelve actual paid days ran from Day Nine Hundred Sixty-nine through Nine Hundred Eighty, with sixty copper paid before city departure. The timed nonexclusive bench had belonged to that ended appointment. It had not supplied public seminar leadership. Qiu read the exit clauses again and separated the past payment from the current receiving access. No exclusive factory wage followed Yue into the independently funded grain work, and the old bench was not an invisible instrument she still owned.

reservoir_ep06_020.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_020.text: The numbered component extract had been used only within its offered receiving purpose. Jing and Qiu checked its source label against the report before preparing the return. The full private reference sheet had never become a public household chart. Yue could describe her own permitted observation and the local ordinary cover inspection, but would not retain a proprietary design for later study. The narrower path had supplied a particular technical comparison and closed a broader public role. Its completion would not make those opportunities interchangeable.

reservoir_ep06_021.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_021.text: The designated local custodian scheduled the actual extract handover and access closure before the seventy-fourth-day limit. Yue's earned practice record remained hers to offer to a future qualified examiner, while borrowed source material stayed with its owner. A new reservoir course would generate its own blanks, sampling records and cleared tasks. It would not ask the factory's old term to finance or certify the new work. Qiu marked the ending date beside the custodian's authority and left the report's final signature waiting for its actual receiving day.

reservoir_ep06_022.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_022.text: Yue's retained decision had declined a new city observer or factory post after separately completed ordinary work. No thirty-six-copper observer service or sixty-copper factory term could be entered as her wages. She had traveled with her actual earlier earnings and permitted private notes. Qiu checked that the receiving file had granted no borrowed institutional role since arrival. The basin grain appointment stood on its own paid demonstration and current source. The independent path had required more requests from the beginning, and those requests remained real work rather than proof of a missing endorsement.

reservoir_ep06_023.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_023.text: Her closing account named the public facts the basin itself had permitted and the observations she had actually made. There was no numbered factory extract to hand back and no collective observer copy to transfer. Private household originals had already returned to their owners. Qiu accepted the modest source list for its actual purpose. Yue felt less tempted to decorate the plain folder than on the first lower-house morning. It now contained completed local work whose ordinary cause could be explained without making the winter city speak on her behalf.

reservoir_ep06_024.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_024.text: The receiver would close the independent visitor inquiry at the same final term review, with no inherited city wage or mandate extended. Yue could retain her own permitted notes and earned practice record. A future course or basin service would need a fresh qualification and fund. The empty institutional-title space was not an injury that Qiu could repair by filling in a more flattering option. It described a road Yue had chosen. She had gained freedom to ask anew and lost ready access, and had made something useful from the actual combination.

reservoir_ep06_025.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_025.text: On Day One Thousand Sixty-seven, the new study receiver asked for Yue's earned practice record and a description of the actual tasks she could safely perform. The request did not ask for a private factory design, a household's covered calendar or her mother's medical letter. Yue liked its clarity. She prepared her own recovered records and the ordinary work references Zhou had permitted. A future qualified examiner could compare those sources directly. The old city-access path would close on its own terms first, rather than becoming an excuse to skip a new receiver's questions.

reservoir_ep06_026.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_026.text: Zhou read the proposed ordinary work portion of the study inquiry. He said a grain receiver could confirm Yue's actual copying and weighing skills, but not pronounce her reservoir ready for a higher stage. Yue asked him to keep that limit in the reference. Tian offered to add the basket incident as proof of courage. Zhou said the brief waist-height pull and subsequent ordinary check could remain a factual account if needed, but courage would not calibrate an instrument. Tian removed the grander heading and looked satisfied with the smaller truth.

reservoir_ep06_027.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_027.text: Qiu supplied the current source for the basin's public operating boundaries. A later student could observe or perform only specifically accepted tasks, with ownership and household turns unchanged. The proposed course had an independent receiver and would need its own real allocation. Yue had seen grants described as if a promising apprentice's need made money appear. Here she would wait for the source, the appointments and the stopping rules. That waiting was tolerable now because the current grain work and personal five-day reserve actually covered the intervening ordinary life.

reservoir_ep06_028.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_028.text: Jing had a more immediate problem: one numbered blank sleeve would not close smoothly after maintenance. She stopped its usable inventory entry and asked the qualified repair worker to inspect the ordinary latch. Yue watched from the public doorway while the small fault was compared. The device could be withdrawn without making Jing's entire cupboard unreliable or a candidate's future sampling free. When the replacement fitting was accepted, Jing recorded its actual cost under the maintenance order. Her care for particular objects had begun to look like a form of patience Yue wanted to learn.

reservoir_ep06_029.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_029.text: That evening, Fu said the study invitation sounded exciting and exhausting. Yue agreed. A balanced reservoir would need to remain usable through real changed days, not just the quiet morning she could arrange when nothing else happened. Fu asked whether that meant the examiner would wake her all night. Yue said no condition had been preregistered yet, and dangerous deprivation would not become acceptable because it might produce an interesting story. Fu nodded, then said she would still be terrible company before breakfast under any realm. Yue promised not to put that claim in a formal trial.

reservoir_ep06_030.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_030.text: On Day One Thousand Sixty-eight, Yue completed her fourteenth accepted grain day. Zhou had scheduled a final older-account comparison that required careful ordinary attention but no physical handling. The half-unit rejection, nominal sack count and corrected storage date remained consistent with their source entries. Tian supplied the accepted public versions, proud that he could now explain each difference without memorizing Yue's phrasing. She had helped him learn a method, not given him a personal ability that would vanish when she left. The completed day's three copper brought her earned total to forty-two before the private dispatch already paid.

reservoir_ep06_031.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_031.text: The meal receiver asked Yue to confirm the last provision dates through the seventy-fourth. She would remain for the actual scheduled work, then use her own reserved money during the gap. The visitor house marked that transition, keeping the two source accounts apart. Yue did not mind the ordinary form because it answered a real practical question. It let the cook prepare the right number of bowls and the lodging keeper know whose bed charge had a funded receiver. She could enjoy being expected without being housed by an indefinite promise nobody had priced.

reservoir_ep06_032.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_032.text: Liu met her by the public garden and asked whether a future eighth stage would make water disputes easier. Yue said it might make a named bounded task more dependable if she passed its conditions, but it would not decide a household's consent. He considered this, then asked whether it would at least make burnt bread less disappointing. She said she had found no such tested capability. He sighed theatrically and offered the unburnt middle of a loaf. The basin's practical questions could coexist with jokes about the things cultivation plainly did not solve.

reservoir_ep06_033.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_033.text: The future grant receiver confirmed that the teaching trust, regional work-study guild and basin training board would consider a separately funded local term after current closure. Their appointed representatives would inspect actual funds and qualifications before release. Yue had not yet accepted the term or begun new instruction. The invitation allowed her to attend the receiving comparison on Day One Thousand Seventy-eight. She wrote the date beside her personal gap reserve. The next door now had a real appointment rather than a helpful person's suggestion that somebody somewhere would surely pay.

reservoir_ep06_034.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_034.text: On Day One Thousand Sixty-nine, a private forwarding acknowledgment reported that Yue's newest family letter had entered its next actual route. There was no reply yet, and the notice asked for no emergency journey. Yue kept the little source and spent her free afternoon mending ordinary clothes. The old blue patch held beside the newer brown thread. She decided to wear the repaired garment to the study receiver instead of buying something more impressive. Their question would concern current work and recovered practice. A neat expensive coat could not answer it better than an accurate record.

reservoir_ep06_035.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_035.text: Jing helped match a thread shade and failed badly enough that they laughed. The patch looked even more conspicuous when the new thread dried. Yue said her mother would approve because it was now impossible to mislay. Jing asked whether that was the household's official aesthetic. Yue answered that it had survived several independently changed conditions. The joke belonged to two friends sewing ordinary cloth. It needed no apparatus, owned resource transfer or prediction about a stage. She liked how their shared technical language had also learned to be silly.

reservoir_ep06_036.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_036.text: On Day One Thousand Seventy, Qiu prepared the final source-return shelf. The city agent's authorization, actual report scope and expiration date remained attached. Yue checked that private household material had not wandered into the institutional packet. Fu confirmed her permitted public paragraph and declined to add a new anecdote that belonged to her brother. The account stayed useful without becoming exhaustive. Tian carried the blank closing form to the desk. His basket was finally too small for all the paperwork, so he made two ordinary trips rather than balancing a second stack above his head.

reservoir_ep06_037.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_037.text: The second trip became a supper joke before he reached the meal house. Tian accused Yue of starting it. She said he had delivered the evidence himself. Zhou asked everybody to leave the basket's professional reputation intact long enough for the closing term, and Fu declared that the basket had shown admirable judgment in requiring two trips. The room was loud and warm again. Yue imagined missing it during a home visit, then reminded herself that missing something valuable was part of choosing where to be, rather than proof that every journey would be a mistake.

reservoir_ep06_038.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_038.text: On Day One Thousand Seventy-one, Yue completed her fifteenth accepted grain day. Zhou compared the finished source list with the ordinary current-store records and accepted the scheduled interval. Her three-copper wage brought the earned total to forty-five before the private dispatch expense. One final day remained. Tian had enough confidence to ask her about a questionable copied heading without making the question an apology. They found the right source and corrected it together. Yue realized she could leave a workplace partly because another person no longer needed her to answer every ordinary uncertainty.

reservoir_ep06_039.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_039.text: Qiu asked whether she wanted a copy of the whole basin operating book before closing. It was a deliberate test of her stated source boundaries, offered as a question rather than a real permission. Yue said her current role did not require it. Qiu showed the limited public reference she could legitimately request in the future. Yue grinned and asked whether every departing visitor received that question. The steward admitted she asked people who looked likely to mistake interest for a working mandate. Yue accepted the teasing because the tendency was one she could recognize.

reservoir_ep06_040.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_040.text: At the private table, Yue wrote a short list of what she hoped new instruction would change. Reliable retention through defined altered conditions came first. She wanted to stop mistaking reserve capacity for currently usable charge and to account for sampling and task discharge without making a favorable total conceal a cost. The list concerned her own lower-dantian reservoir and already earned routes. No higher throughput, new range, healing ability or opened spiritual center would follow merely from a better stage caption. Those questions would need their own future qualified evidence.

reservoir_ep06_041.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_041.text: She also wrote what she hoped a family visit would contain: an ordinary shared meal, her mother's chosen account of the kiln, a useful question about the shelf and enough time not to make every conversation feel like departure preparation. The two lists did not cancel each other. They would compete for particular days once the actual course and family answers existed. Yue folded them separately, pleased that neither had ended in a grand promise to become someone who could finally do everything without asking what another person wanted.

reservoir_ep06_042.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_042.text: On Day One Thousand Seventy-two, the study receiver acknowledged her permitted application sources. The new course's decision would be independent of the old city's public or private role. Her references could establish previous earned practice and ordinary competence, but the reservoir trial would generate its own results. Yue would need a funded qualified appointment before any new sample or supervised load. The message contained no pass prediction. She accepted the seventy-eighth-day receiving time and let the actual source-return review remain tomorrow's task, which was concrete enough to finish without borrowing a future certificate.

reservoir_ep06_043.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_043.text: On the final local receiving day, Qiu accepted the collective observer report and its returned access counterpart under the designated authority. The city account remained thirty-six already-paid copper for the earlier twelve-day term. The basin's household sources stayed with their actual keepers. Yue kept no claim to the declined factory stipend, its bench or private sheet. The receiving mark closed the bounded public access before any new qualified instruction began. Its onward acknowledgment would use the real courier route and add no new service days.

reservoir_ep06_044.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_044.text: Fu read the permitted public paragraph about the household trial and accepted its limited wording. The report used the selected mechanism and its real costs, rather than claiming both alternative plans had happened. Liu's private family details were absent. Tian carried the accepted institutional counterpart to its dispatch shelf under his current paid task. The collective introduction had led to an actual comparison whose source could now remain useful without Yue standing beside every reader. Its closing gave the public record a receiver rather than a permanently available visitor.

reservoir_ep06_045.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_045.text: Yue put her own permitted notebook into the private pack. The cooperative's earlier endorsement stayed scoped to completed work and did not preapprove a new examination result. Qiu signed the access closure and removed its active entry from the current request list. A fresh term could later invite Yue again, but it would need a real offer. Today the ending was complete. The broader public opportunity and the lost factory stipend remained part of the history she carried, while the next institution would decide its own question.

reservoir_ep06_046.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_046.text: On the final local receiving day, the designated custodian accepted the numbered factory extract and Yue's limited report. Jing counted the returned permitted page against its handling entry. The earlier sixty-copper city wage and twelve completed comparison days stayed in their closed account; no new factory payment was due. The timed bench did not travel with the folder. Qiu closed the private receiving access under its actual authority before any new reservoir instruction, leaving the onward acknowledgment to its ordinary courier rather than an invented immediate receipt.

reservoir_ep06_047.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_047.text: The report described the actual offered component comparison and the basin's independent ordinary cover inspection. It contained no copied full design and no public-seminar role that Yue had never accepted. The households' restricted originals stayed outside it. Jing was satisfied that the source had been returned without being turned into a candidate's private equipment archive. Tian delivered the sealed counterpart to the dispatch shelf under his current task, curious enough to ask one question and sensible enough to accept that the private sheet was not his to inspect.

reservoir_ep06_048.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_048.text: Yue retained her own permitted notes and earned practice record, with the institutional extract removed. The narrower city path had made a particular comparison possible and kept other rooms closed. Its ending did not undo that result. Qiu signed the current access list closed and told the household receiver that future private requests would need a new purpose. Yue would meet any next examiner with fresh local evidence and her actual prior record, rather than borrowing a former contract's apparatus or prestige to make the new test easier.

reservoir_ep06_049.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_049.text: On the final local receiving day, Qiu closed the independent visitor inquiry and accepted its limited ordinary account. Yue returned every basin paper whose offered use had ended. No factory extract or cooperative observer role had been borrowed from an option she declined. Her earlier city wages remained only the ordinary work actually completed, with no invented new-term payment. The separately funded grain commission had supplied the real livelihood here. Its records would close through their own receiver, not through a borrowed city's endorsement.

reservoir_ep06_050.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_050.text: Tian placed the permitted public counterpart on the basin shelf while Fu retained her own household originals. The account named the selected water mechanism, actual travel sources and the limits of the observations Yue could offer. Qiu checked the private folder only with Yue's permission to verify the returned institutional items, leaving family correspondence covered. The independent route had required additional requests and a slower beginning. It had also left an ending with no unacknowledged employer or instrument debt following the visitor into a new course.

reservoir_ep06_051.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_051.text: Yue kept her earned practice record and private notes, without a collective endorsement or proprietary reference sheet. Qiu removed the ended inquiry from the active request list. Any future source access would begin with its own consent. The plain folder felt familiar now, less like evidence that she had arrived without the right introduction. She had completed accepted local work and helped a real household choice. Those facts could be offered accurately to a future receiver, who would still decide whether a different opportunity belonged to her.

reservoir_ep06_052.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_052.text: After the actual local city-access handover on Day One Thousand Seventy-three, Yue went to the public veranda without the return folder. The space in her pack felt surprisingly light. Qiu's active request list no longer carried the old receiving term, and every source item had its actual custodian. Yue could still remember the conversations and retain permitted private notes. Ending access did not require forgetting. It required letting a familiar institution stop answering for her before she asked a different one to decide what came next.

reservoir_ep06_053.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_053.text: Fu brought the accepted household counterpart home under her own scope. Liu took his public summary, still grumbling that nobody had copied the bread joke. Tian said it belonged in his private historical collection, a claim Zhou disputed loudly enough to make the cook look out of the meal-room door. The formal term had ended; the people were still there. Yue was relieved that their ordinary company had not depended on her remaining appointed to every source she had once helped explain.

reservoir_ep06_054.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_054.text: Zhou offered a possible later copying appointment with a stated beginning after the current close. It would have its own wages and ordinary hours if accepted. The job could not be held indefinitely while Yue waited through a new study course. She thanked him and said the independent receiving decision on the seventy-eighth would determine whether she could apply. Zhou needed an answer sooner and gave the available work to a qualified local applicant. Yue felt the lost opening. The hoped course now cost something concrete even before it promised any new ability.

reservoir_ep06_055.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_055.text: She did not ask Zhou to leave the ordinary worker waiting. The applicant had actual living expenses and a demonstrated skill. Yue's own completed wages and reserved five-day bridge covered her next decision interval. There was no universal judgment hidden in the different timing: another copying job could be good work, and a funded reservoir course could be the road she wanted. She sat with that loss at supper, then listened to Tian explain how the new worker could inherit the shelf without inheriting every basket joke against their will.

reservoir_ep06_056.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_056.text: The newly appointed copying worker visited the public table before her own term began. She asked Yue whether the canceled forms had been preserved by date or by source. Yue showed the permitted index and let her compare it herself. The woman preferred a different margin mark because she read the old ink poorly in evening light. Zhou accepted the proposed ordinary adjustment for the new term. The workplace would continue changing after its visitor stopped deciding where each useful line belonged.

reservoir_ep06_057.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_057.text: Tian looked briefly offended on behalf of the familiar margin. Then the new worker showed him why her suggested mark was easier to read beside a corrected number. He tried it and admitted the difference. Yue watched them work without stepping between every sentence. Leaving could mean trusting another person's method after a real comparison, rather than preserving her own arrangement as if gratitude required everyone to keep it forever.

reservoir_ep06_058.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_058.text: At supper, Tian said the basket would approve the clearer mark. Zhou asked when its authority had become so extensive. The new worker laughed and said she would request its credentials before accepting any inspection. Yue enjoyed seeing the joke survive without needing her explanation. Something she liked about this table would remain here while she stood at the next one.

reservoir_ep06_059.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_059.text: On Day One Thousand Seventy-four, Yue completed her sixteenth and final accepted grain day. Zhou compared the closing source list and actual current-store statement against the retained originals. Her thirty-two accepted ordinary work intervals had combined into sixteen posted day equivalents; no social visit or private letter had been charged as another. The final three-copper wage made forty-eight actually paid for the full commission. Yue had already spent one on her family dispatch. Forty-seven of those grain wages remained available before the privately reserved gap costs.

reservoir_ep06_060.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_060.text: The other local workers' seventeen accepted equivalents had cost fifty-one copper. Paper, seals and ordinary comparison materials reconciled the accepted three. The visitor food and lodging orders covered their forty-nine actual days and nights through this last night's accepted place. Their ninety-eight was separate from wages. Together those real lines completed the two-hundred-copper grain allocation. The store's usable quantity and half-unit rejection remained physical inventory facts, rather than money secretly created by a tidy closing calculation. Zhou retained the actual source account where the next receiver could inspect it.

reservoir_ep06_061.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_061.text: Tian gave Yue a permitted public copy of the source index, with no private household sheet or proprietary city extract tucked inside. Its purpose was ordinary reference to the work she had actually completed. She thanked him and admired the tiny basket he had drawn on the separate gift scrap. He said he had finally learned to keep pictures out of required margins. Zhou examined the scrap and pronounced its carrying angle doubtful. Yue promised to forward any matching criticism her mother chose to send.

reservoir_ep06_062.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_062.text: At the evening table, Qiu asked which contact should hold the new application response. Yue named the current visitor house's receiver through the priced gap, then the study receiving desk if a real offer was accepted. Her family forwarding route would be updated after the actual decision. There was no new public mandate, factory post or basin instrument loan waiting in the pack. She had finished the old obligations and earned enough ordinary money to stand at the next door without asking that door to pretend it had already opened.

reservoir_ep06_063.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_063.text: Jing brought her ordinary blue thread for their last mending interval under this house term. The button repair remained uneven and strong. Yue joked that it had survived the visitor period more reliably than her first idea of the basin. Jing said the actual basin was allowed to have wind, canceled intervals and people taking other jobs. They sat with the thread while the room darkened. Yue wanted the next course, but she also wanted to remember that this imperfect place had become worth staying in before any certificate made it impressive.

reservoir_ep06_064.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_064.text: The final grain-funded night was accepted under the lodging order, with its actual closing receipt. The following five nights and meals would use the ten copper Yue had reserved from completed wages. That left thirty-seven uncommitted grain copper after the paid family dispatch and ten reserved gap copper, apart from the real travel remainder still kept separately. She could accept the new study decision interval without using an unreceived grant. A longer stay after refusal would require another actual livelihood choice; the present five-day bridge was simply a bounded way to hear the offer.

reservoir_ep06_065.speaker: narrator
reservoir_ep06_065.text: Before sleeping, Yue put the private application sources beside the old blue cloth patch. Her mother's latest reply remained inside its own cover. She would meet a new receiver with prior earned practice, actual ordinary references and no borrowed source authority pretending to be competence. The basin beyond the shutter was dark and audible. Tomorrow's ordinary roof and food were priced, the old terms were closed, and the next appointment had a real date. She let those modest completed facts be enough for the night.
